name: nginx-monitor
description: Slack watchdog for open-source NGINX stub_status.

scripts.check: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process'); for (const file of ['nginx-monitor.js', ...fs.readdirSync('src').filter((name) => name.endsWith('.js')).map((name) => 'src/' + name)]) execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', file], { stdio: 'inherit' })"
